full_metrics.latency_method: reference voiced onset to first valid tracker frame within 100 cents

25-50.latency_method: reference voiced onset to first valid tracker frame within 100 cents

50-75.latency_method: reference voiced onset to first valid tracker frame within 100 cents

75-110.latency_method: reference voiced onset to first valid tracker frame within 100 cents

110-200.latency_method: reference voiced onset to first valid tracker frame within 100 cents

definition.stable_region: five consecutive voiced, valid, within-100-cent frames with every reference frame delta <= 10 cents
definition.micro_jump: a >=35-cent tracked frame step in a stable region that returns within 18 cents of its prior value within four causal hops
definition.frame_delta: absolute cents difference between adjacent tracked frames in stable regions

definitions.attack: first 100 ms after each pYIN unvoiced-to-voiced boundary
definitions.transition: 100 ms after a >=30-cent pYIN frame step
definitions.slide_or_bend: frames in the fixed named slide windows
definitions.decay: voiced, falling envelope below 45% of the preceding 480-ms peak

transition.definition: reference step >=80 cents settling within three frames; lag is first subsequent tracker frame within 50 cents
